# NovaEyes

> NovaEyes is a performance-based clipping agency founded in 2025 by Andrea Corindo in Ferrara, Italy. Clients fund a view pool and pay per 1,000 verified short-form views, delivered by a network of 20,000 clippers across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X. Campaigns start at $3,000, and most go live within 48 hours of brief approval.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://nova-eyes.com/): what a clipping agency is and how a NovaEyes campaign works
- [About](https://nova-eyes.com/about): who runs NovaEyes, the founder and the campaigns we can show
- [Case studies](https://nova-eyes.com/case-studies): campaign results with views, CPM and clip counts
- [Pricing](https://nova-eyes.com/pricing): how clipping is priced, what changes the CPM, and CPMs from past campaigns
- [Reach estimator](https://nova-eyes.com/reach-estimator): views for a budget, or the budget for a view target
- [The Attention Monopoly System](https://nova-eyes.com/attention-monopoly-system): the three-step method behind every campaign
- [FAQ](https://nova-eyes.com/faq): pricing, results, reporting, brand safety and rights
- [Book a call](https://nova-eyes.com/book)

## Clipping by vertical

- [Music clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/music-clipping): songs pushed through thousands of clips to drive streams
- [Podcast clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/podcast-clipping): episodes cut into clips that bring new listeners
- [Combat sports clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/combat-sports-clipping): fight footage turned into highlight clips
- [Logo clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/logo-clipping): a brand's logo, promo code and link on clips that already perform
- [Product clipping](https://nova-eyes.com/product-clipping): creators showing a product in new short clips

## Selected results

- Alex Schor (music): 189,974,866 views at $0.13 CPM across 2,444 clips in 4 months; Spotify monthly listeners grew from 170K to 650K
- BRAVE CF (combat sports): 52,131,046 views at $0.21 CPM across 5,247 clips in 6 weeks; estimated $700K revenue impact
- Oktagon MMA (combat sports, Oktagon 94 Frankfurt): 20,833,959 views across 5,297 clips in 19 days at €0.36 CPM; one YouTube Short reached 5.79M views
- Ahmed Amwell: 8.4M views at $0.36 CPM on a $3,000 budget, 1,706 clips in 20 days
- Family Ties (podcast with Tobi Brown): 7.2M views at $0.41 CPM on a $3,000 budget, 843 clips; 2M+ additional YouTube views
- Sparkle (music): 4.7M views at $0.21 CPM in 3 days

All figures come from NovaEyes campaign dashboards.
